{{Quote|You'll find Count Alde at the embassy near Organa Palace.|General [[Var Suthra]]|<ref name="Death Mark" />}}
The [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family [[House Alde]] maintained an '''embassy''' on the grounds of the [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa estate]], the ancestral home of fellow [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ally [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Aleyna Hark]] infiltrated the embassy and tagged [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Alde (Count)|Alde]] with the targeting device for the [[Death Mark laser]], a weapons [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Alderaan, and the Death Mark's orbital [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Count while he was still inside the structure. After the death of the Count, the embassy's guards closed the building to the public.

==Description==
As an ally of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family [[House Alde]] occupied a building on the western grounds of [[Castle Organa]], the home of House Organa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], to use as their embassy. The building contained a hallway with numerous turns that linked the entrance to the main conference room, which was a large circular chamber containing tables and chairs for [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] discussions. Like many buildings on Alderaan, it featured large statues, tan flooring, and a [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme of crimson and gold. The embassy was protected by guards under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yils]], as well as under [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Alde (Count)|Alde]], who conducted business there when he was visiting Castle Organa.<ref name="Death Mark" />

==History==
{{Quote|The embassy is closed. Please vacate the premises.|Yils, after the death of Count Alde|<ref name="Death Mark" />}}
[[File:House_Alde_embassy.png|thumb|right|200px|The interior of the embassy]]
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Count Alde was visiting the embassy when the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Aleyna Hark]] arrived, claiming to be the only survivor of an [[Attack on the Mensaav Military Laboratory|attack]] on the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory|Mensaav Laboratory]]&mdash;a facility where the Republic was working on the weapon known as the [[Death Mark laser]] using Alde funding. A [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who had been sent to secure the Death Mark [[Laser/Legends|laser]] soon joined Count Alde, but Hark&mdash;actually an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]]&mdash;took the opportunity to tag the Count with the targeting device of the Death Mark. During their conversation, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nefarid]] activated the Death Mark [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above Alderaan, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Count Alde with a laser strike. Captain Yils and his men charged into the conference room to find the Count dead with Hark, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight's]] companion thrown to the floor.<ref name="Death Mark" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Ignoring their attempts to explain, Yils ordered his men to arrest the trio for the death of the Count. However, Yils was convinced to allow the Knight to leave, either by the Jedi's [[Mind trick/Legends|use]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] or by Hark's offer to remain in custody until the Knight returned. After the Knight's departure, Yils and his subordinates closed the embassy to the public.<ref name="Death Mark" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Alde embassy first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]], as a class-restricted location for the Jedi Knight class mission "The Death Mark." Yils can either be fought for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alignment points, or convinced to release the Knight for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points.<ref name="Death Mark" /> As a Republic character, the Jedi Knight is assumed to only choose the light side options,<ref name="Light Side">It is assumed that the Republic classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> so this article assumes the Knight left without fighting the guards.<ref name="Death Mark" />
